∀ β : Module.Basis (Chevalley.Index ell) K (Chevalley.VK K M),
 (∀ (F : Module.End ℤ M) (f : Module.End ℂ V),
 (∀ u : Chevalley.MR p M, Chevalley.mu p M (F.baseChange (Chevalley.R p) u) = f (Chevalley.mu p M u)) →
 ∀ (i j : Chevalley.Index ell) (z : ℤ),
 f (Chevalley.e y v i.val) = (z : ℂ) • Chevalley.e y v j.val →
 F.baseChange K (β i) = (z : K) • β j) → Chevalley.stringActions ell (Chevalley.opK K M x) (Chevalley.opK K M y) (Chevalley.opK K M h) (Chevalley.basisVec β) ∧
 Chevalley.dividedActions ell (fun r => Chevalley.opK K M (Chevalley.dp x r)) (fun r => Chevalley.opK K M (Chevalley.dp y r)) (Chevalley.basisVec β)
proof:
classical
intro β tr
have trans (F : Module.End ℤ M) (f : Module.End ℂ V)
    (hf : ∀ u : Chevalley.MR p M, Chevalley.mu p M (F.baseChange (Chevalley.R p) u) = f (Chevalley.mu p M u))
    (i j : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ ell.toNat) (hj : j ≤ ell.toNat) (z : ℤ)
    (he : f (Chevalley.e y v i) = (z : ℂ) • Chevalley.e y v j) :
    F.baseChange K (Chevalley.basisVec β i) = (z : K) • Chevalley.basisVec β j := by
  simpa [Chevalley.basisVec, Nat.lt_succ_iff.mpr hi, Nat.lt_succ_iff.mpr hj] using
    tr F f hf ⟨i, Nat.lt_succ_iff.mpr hi⟩ ⟨j, Nat.lt_succ_iff.mpr hj⟩ z he
have trans0 (F : Module.End ℤ M) (f : Module.End ℂ V)
    (hf : ∀ u : Chevalley.MR p M, Chevalley.mu p M (F.baseChange (Chevalley.R p) u) = f (Chevalley.mu p M u))
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ ell.toNat) (he : f (Chevalley.e y v i) = 0) :
    F.baseChange K (Chevalley.basisVec β i) = 0 := by
  simpa [Chevalley.opK] using trans F f hf i i hi hi 0 (by simpa using he)
have hx := @yui_aux_0002 V instV instCV K instK p ell x y h v M h_H001 h_T004 h_T006 h_T012 h_T013 x h_T006.1.2.2.2.2.2.1
have hy := @yui_aux_0002 V instV instCV K instK p ell x y h v M h_H001 h_T004 h_T006 h_T012 h_T013 y h_T006.1.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
have hh := @yui_aux_0002 V instV instCV K instK p ell x y h v M h_H001 h_T004 h_T006 h_T012 h_T013 h h_T006.1.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
have hd := h_T006.1.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2
have hs := h_T004.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
have ha := h_T004.2.2.2.2.2.2.2
constructor
· intro i hi
  rcases hs i hi with ⟨hxi, hyi, hhi⟩
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · by_cases hz : i = 0
    · simp only [hz, if_pos rfl] at hxi ⊢
      exact trans0 _ _ hx 0 (by omega) hxi
    · simp only [if_neg hz] at hxi ⊢
      exact trans _ _ hx i (i-1) hi (by omega) (ell - (i : ℤ) + 1) hxi
  · by_cases ht : i < ell.toNat
    · simp only [if_pos ht] at hyi ⊢
      simpa [Chevalley.opK] using trans _ _ hy i (i+1) hi (by omega) ((i+1 : ℕ) : ℤ) (by simpa using hyi)
    · simp only [if_neg ht] at hyi ⊢
      exact trans0 _ _ hy i hi hyi
  · exact trans _ _ hh i i hi hi (ell - 2 * (i : ℤ)) hhi
· intro r i hi
  rcases ha r i hi with ⟨hxi, hyi⟩
  constructor
  · by_cases ht : r ≤ i
    · simp only [if_pos ht] at hxi ⊢
      simpa [Chevalley.opK] using trans _ _ (fun u => (hd r u).1) i (i-r) hi (by omega)
        ((Nat.choose (ell.toNat-i+r) r : ℕ) : ℤ) (by simpa using hxi)
    · simp only [if_neg ht] at hxi ⊢
      exact trans0 _ _ (fun u => (hd r u).1) i hi hxi
  · by_cases ht : i+r ≤ ell.toNat
    · simp only [if_pos ht] at hyi ⊢
      simpa [Chevalley.opK] using trans _ _ (fun u => (hd r u).2) i (i+r) hi ht
        ((Nat.choose (i+r) r : ℕ) : ℤ) (by simpa using hyi)
    · simp only [if_neg ht] at hyi ⊢
      exact trans0 _ _ (fun u => (hd r u).2) i hi hyi

checked : ∀ (V : Type) [instV : AddCommGroup V] [instCV : _root_.Module ℂ V] (K : Type) [instK : Field K] (p : ℕ)
  (ell : ℤ) (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V),
  Nat.Prime p ∧ CharP K p ∧ 0 ≤ ell ∧ ell < ↑p →
    0 < ell.toNat + 1 ∧
        Fintype.card (Chevalley.Index ell) = ell.toNat + 1 ∧
          Module.finrank ℂ V = ell.toNat + 1 ∧
            ((∀ (t : ℕ), h ((y ^ t) v) = (↑ell - 2 * ↑t) • (y ^ t) v) ∧
                ∀ (t : ℕ), 0 < t → x ((y ^ t) v) = (↑t * (↑ell - ↑t + 1)) • (y ^ (t - 1)) v) ∧
              (∃ b, ∀ (i : Chevalley.Index ell), b i = Chevalley.e y v ↑i) ∧
                (∀ (t : ℕ), ell.toNat < t → (y ^ t) v = 0) ∧
                  Chevalley.stringActions ell x y h (Chevalley.e y v) ∧
                    Chevalley.dividedActions ell (Chevalley.dp x) (Chevalley.dp y) (Chevalley.e y v) →
      (((∀ (q : ℚ), q ∈ Chevalley.R p ↔ ∃ a b, ¬↑p ∣ b ∧ q = ↑a / ↑b) ∧
            Function.Injective (Chevalley.mu p M) ∧
              Nonempty (Module.Basis (Chevalley.Index ell) (↥(Chevalley.R p)) (Chevalley.MR p M)) ∧
                Submodule.span ℂ (Chevalley.image p M) = ⊤ ∧
                  (∀ (r : ℕ), Chevalley.inImage p M (Chevalley.dp x r) ∧ Chevalley.inImage p M (Chevalley.dp y r)) ∧
                    Chevalley.preserves M x ∧
                      Chevalley.preserves M y ∧
                        Chevalley.preserves M h ∧
                          ∀ (r : ℕ) (u : Chevalley.MR p M),
                            Chevalley.mu p M
                                  ((LinearMap.baseChange (↥(Chevalley.R p)) (Chevalley.latticeOp M (Chevalley.dp x r)))
                                    u) =
                                (Chevalley.dp x r) (Chevalley.mu p M u) ∧
                              Chevalley.mu p M
                                  ((LinearMap.baseChange (↥(Chevalley.R p)) (Chevalley.latticeOp M (Chevalley.dp y r)))
                                    u) =
                                (Chevalley.dp y r) (Chevalley.mu p M u)) ∧
          ∀ (b : Module.Basis (Chevalley.Index ell) ℂ V),
            (∀ (i : Chevalley.Index ell), b i = Chevalley.e y v ↑i) →
              ∀ (i j : Chevalley.Index ell),
                IsUnit ↑(ell.toNat.choose ↑j) ∧
                  Chevalley.dp y ell.toNat * Chevalley.dp x ell.toNat =
                      Chevalley.unitOp b (Fin.last ell.toNat) (Fin.last ell.toNat) ∧
                    Chevalley.dp x (ell.toNat - ↑i) * (Chevalley.dp y ell.toNat * Chevalley.dp x ell.toNat) =
                        Chevalley.unitOp b i (Fin.last ell.toNat) ∧
                      Chevalley.dp y ell.toNat * Chevalley.dp x ell.toNat * Chevalley.dp y (ell.toNat - ↑j) =
                          ↑(ell.toNat.choose ↑j) • Chevalley.unitOp b (Fin.last ell.toNat) j ∧
                        Chevalley.unitOp b i j =
                            (↑(ell.toNat.choose ↑j))⁻¹ •
                              (Chevalley.dp x (ell.toNat - ↑i) * (Chevalley.dp y ell.toNat * Chevalley.dp x ell.toNat) *
                                Chevalley.dp y (ell.toNat - ↑j)) ∧
                          Chevalley.inImage p M (Chevalley.unitOp b i j)) →
        (∃ b ∈ Chevalley.J p M y v 0,
            b ≠ 0 ∧
              Chevalley.J p M y v 0 = ↥(Chevalley.R p) ∙ b ∧
                (∀ (u : V),
                    u ∈ Chevalley.image p M ↔
                      ∃ c, u = ∑ i, (algebraMap ↥(Chevalley.R p) ℂ) (c i) • b • Chevalley.e y v ↑i) ∧
                  ∃ B,
                    ∀ (i : Chevalley.Index ell),
                      Chevalley.mu p M (B i) = b • Chevalley.e y v ↑i ∧
                        ∀ (u : Chevalley.MR p M), Chevalley.mu p M u = b • Chevalley.e y v ↑i → u = B i) →
          Chevalley.reductions K p M →
            ∀ (β : Module.Basis (Chevalley.Index ell) K (Chevalley.VK K M)),
              (∀ (F : Module.End ℤ ↥M) (f : Module.End ℂ V),
                  (∀ (u : Chevalley.MR p M),
                      Chevalley.mu p M ((LinearMap.baseChange (↥(Chevalley.R p)) F) u) = f (Chevalley.mu p M u)) →
                    ∀ (i j : Chevalley.Index ell) (z : ℤ),
                      f (Chevalley.e y v ↑i) = ↑z • Chevalley.e y v ↑j → (LinearMap.baseChange K F) (β i) = ↑z • β j) →
                Chevalley.stringActions ell (Chevalley.opK K M x) (Chevalley.opK K M y) (Chevalley.opK K M h)
                    (Chevalley.basisVec β) ∧
                  Chevalley.dividedActions ell (fun r => Chevalley.opK K M (Chevalley.dp x r))
                    (fun r => Chevalley.opK K M (Chevalley.dp y r)) (Chevalley.basisVec β)
